# Mono release notices

These are unmodified files read from the pinned Mono 6.8.0.105 source archive.
PROVENANCE.json records archive identity, original paths, sizes and SHA-256.
LICENSE describes the MIT runtime and third-party exceptions; it is not a claim
that every assembly in the full Mono distribution has the same license.

The release tarball omits root PATENTS.TXT. That file was recovered from the exact
mono-6.8.0.105 Git tag, commit 82fffe0749720025ec5f7a72eae7329295ea15a4; its LICENSE
matches the tarball byte-for-byte. Supplemental provenance records the immutable
URL and hash. Four component patent files retain their original paths.

extracted-notices contains verbatim leading comment blocks from the pinned
SharpZipLib and RabbitMQ source files. Provenance records the original source hash
and line interval. These selected notices do not certify complete assembly coverage.

InstallRuntimeNotices.ps1 stages these verified files for modern Editor/Player.
No Mono code, library or executable is bundled in this directory.
